purpose: Test whether the temporal graph model adds complementary information to the strong temporal random-forest baseline.
blend_grid: alpha in {0.00, 0.05, ..., 1.00}; alpha multiplies temporal RF prediction
selection: alpha selected on validation cells using raw-scale MAE; test labels are read only once for final evaluation
gate: If the validation-selected blend improves test MAE over temporal RF for both analytes, expand to seeds 42-44; otherwise stop GNN architecture expansion and retain temporal RF as the primary model.
